required_outputs: Per public requirement, concrete named positive/error/default/state/concurrency/platform variants, controlled input and observable output/effect/assertion, applicable source span and owner; no generic axis-only acceptance.
Classify public API/CLI/tool/RPC/TUI outcomes separately from private implementation metadata; do not require literal private Rust ABI in native CVG or count callbacks/fields/types as functions.
For each source-only gap, separate source classification/variant completeness (G01) from functional/reference/build/package obligations (G02 onward); preserve runtime NOT_RUN.
Resolve ambiguous owner/domain relations explicitly using direct dispatch/behavior evidence; nearest symbol or same file does not prove semantic ownership.
Publish scope-closure audit verdict and named unresolved obligations. Only close G01 if its zero-unclassified-public-surface criterion has evidence; do not infer closure from counts.

g02_parallel_preparation.required: Concrete bounded execution/containment/resource/provenance SPEC and gate classification before tools/target execution; no personal credentials

g03_parallel_preparation.required: Own contract/digest/controlled negatives for Codex reuse without duplicating kit or transferring0235/0236authority

g04_preparation.required: Concrete WHAT and public stream/loop/cancel/durable contract; dependencies G02/G03 and explicit T3 review before BUILD

constraints: No further private census by default; inspect additional source only to resolve a named public acceptance ambiguity.
Catalog additions must be additive/owned and independently reviewed; no deleting old IDs or lowering target.
No target/runtime/compiler/toolchain/install/provider/network/resources/build in this next T1 unit without new concrete claim and gate.
